instruction: Add a new list 'Project Team' and include the contacts 'Jane Smith', 'Alex Johnson', and 'Emily Davis'.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "Contacts" to try
set projectGroup to first group whose name is "Project Team"
set groupMembers to people of projectGroup
set janeFound to false
set alexFound to false
set emilyFound to false
repeat with aMember in groupMembers
set memberName to name of aMember
if memberName is "Jane Smith" then
set janeFound to true
else if memberName is "Alex Johnson" then
set alexFound to true
else if memberName is "Emily Davis" then
set emilyFound to true
end if
end repeat
if janeFound and alexFound and emilyFound then
return true
else
return false
end if
on error
return false
end try'
